text: 【音樂】Hello everyone, I'm Miss Q.Nice to see you again.We've learned Model 3, things around us.Today, we will have a revision.First, let's review the sounds.Please read after me.that's zoom mouthm warmn nosen tanl lightl coolr runr orangegood job!Look, spring is warm, autumn is cool.How about summer and winter?How is the weather in four seasons?Let's read rhyme together.spring nice and warmspring I like springsummer sunny and hotsummer I like summerautumn windy and coolautumn I like autumnwinter cloudy and coldwinter winter I like winterWow, different seasons have different weather.Look, Miss Fang and her students are talking about their favorite seasons.They are doing projects.Here is a project.Listen to Miss Fang.Here's a project for you.What season do you like?Spring, summer, autumn or winter?What clothes do you have for the season you like?Please think and tick, and then look and say.OKMiss Fang, please think about it first, and then say your favorite season.What seasons do they like?First, let's look at Kitty.What season does Kitty like?What clothes does Kitty have?Let's watch and tick.I like spring.It is nice and warm.I like riding my bicycle in the park.I have a sweater and trousers for spring.How nice!Yes, spring.Kitty ticks spring.What does Kitty have for spring?Yes, she has a sweater and trousers for spring.Kitty likes spring.What does she like doing in spring?In spring, we like riding our bicycles outside.Wow, in spring, Kitty and Ben like riding their bicycles outside.Where can they ride their bicycles?Yes, in the park or in the children's garden.Kitty and Ben are in the children's garden.Look at the light.It's red.Now, you are Kitty and Ben.Please try to say.OK, let's check the answer.Let's stop.Very good.Look, the light changes.Can you say it again?Alright, listen to them.It's green.Let's go.Excellent.How about the yellow light?Can they go?Alright, let's check.It's yellow.Let's wait.Well done.Children, please remember when you see the lights, we should follow the rules.We know Kitty's favorite season is spring.What does she say?Listen to Kitty.It's your turn.Can you be Kitty and talk about her favorite season?Alright, let's be Kitty together.Good job.How about Danny?What season does Danny like?What clothes does Danny have?Let's listen and tick.Do you like summer?Yes, I do.Summer is sunny and hot.I like swimming in the water.I have shorts for summer.How cool!Can you tick?Look, summer, shorts.So, Danny likes summer.He has shorts for summer.Now, can you be Danny?Please look and say.Okay, let's say it together.I like summer.It is sunny and hot.Great job.We know Kitty likes spring, Danny likes summer.How about Peter and Alice?What are their favorite seasons?Let's look at their projects.Peter likes autumn.He has a coat and trousers for autumn.Alice likes winter.She has a sweater and trousers for winter.Now, please choose and say.You can choose Peter's project or Alice's project, and then look and say.Talk about their favorite seasons.Okay, let's read their favorite seasons together.I like autumn.It is windy and cool.I like flying a kite in the park.I have a coat and trousers for autumn.I like winter.It is cloudy and cold.I like skating on the ice.I have a sweater and trousers for winter.How warm!Nice reading.Look, all the students have finished their projects.How super!What about you?What's your favorite season?Please think and tick the season you like and the clothes you have, and then look and say.Great, kids!After class, you can share the results with your teacher.Tell your teacher about your favorite season.You can also share your favorite season with your teacher.How do you like your summer?I like the summer.In this module, we know things around us.Unit 1, the four seasons.Different seasons have different weather.Unit 2, rules.When we see the lights, we should follow the rules.Unit 3, my clothes.Different clothes for different seasons.Boys and girls, you really did a good job today.Class is over.Goodbye.
